description: This file defines the MockPersistentReportingStore class, a mock implementation of the ReportingCache::PersistentReportingStore interface used for testing. It manages commands related to reporting endpoints and groups, simulates pre-stored clients, and provides methods to verify and manipulate command sequences.

classes.name: MockPersistentReportingStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of the PersistentReportingStore interface for testing reporting-related functionalities.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Represents a command to manipulate reporting endpoints or groups, including load, add, update, delete, and flush operations.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Loads reporting clients and executes the provided callback.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: SetPrestoredClients
methods.description: Sets pre-stored reporting clients and groups for testing.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, optionally indicating success.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies that the command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: CountCommands
methods.description: Counts the number of commands of a specific type.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns all commands executed so far.

methods.name: StoredEndpointsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of stored endpoints.

methods.name: StoredEndpointGroupsCount
methods.description: Returns the number of stored endpoint groups.
